title: Implement accepted project improvement follow-ups
description: Follow-up epic for the accepted improvement ideas from the 2026-05-17 project critique. The first implemented slice already covered content-quality corrections, local backup reminders, and privacy wording. This epic tracks the remaining high-confidence improvements.
acceptance_criteria: Remaining accepted ideas are either implemented and verified, or explicitly deferred with rationale: import/export compatibility tests, corrupt localStorage recovery, and chapter-focused practice queue.
close_reason: Implemented remaining accepted improvement follow-ups: import/export compatibility tests, corrupt localStorage recovery, and chapter-focused vocabulary practice queue. Full verification passed.

title: Add import/export compatibility regression tests
description: Protect the local progress safety net by adding regression tests for every supported progress import/export format. Cover current full export, legacy vocab export, old Spansk Gloselæring export, raw old arrays, direct old localStorage dumps, malformed JSON, and unknown valid JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests prove that supported progress formats import without data loss, malformed/unknown files fail with a clear user-facing error, current export keeps version spansk123_export_v1, and no existing import/export format is removed or silently changed.
close_reason: Added Playwright import/export compatibility coverage for current export, legacy v4, old app exports, raw arrays, localStorage dumps, malformed JSON, and unknown JSON. Routed file import through the tested helpers.

title: Recover gracefully from corrupt localStorage
description: Make local-first storage more resilient when one saved value is malformed or partially corrupted. Guard JSON parsing for vocabulary, grammar progress, practice history, old app data, and import paths where practical. Preserve corrupt payloads under a backup key before resetting that area so the app can still load.
acceptance_criteria: A corrupt spansk123Data_v4, spansk123Grammar_v1, or spansk123_practiceHistory value no longer prevents the app from loading. The app shows a clear Norwegian message, preserves the corrupt payload in a timestamped localStorage backup key, resets only the affected area, and keeps export/import available.
close_reason: Added guarded localStorage parsing with timestamped corrupt-value backups for vocab, grammar, practice history, and old app migration data; covered with Playwright recovery tests.

title: Add chapter-focused vocabulary practice queue
description: Add a chapter-focused fast path that lets students practice a teacher-relevant chapter/category set without losing spaced repetition behavior. Keep due reviews available across all categories, then front-load new or weak cards from the selected chapter focus.
acceptance_criteria: Vocabulary screen offers a clear chapter-focused practice path, students can still use existing review/mixed/new modes and manual category selection, due review cards are not hidden by chapter focus, and the implementation includes a focused browser regression for the queue composition.
close_reason: Added chapter-focused vocabulary queue and UI fast path with Playwright coverage proving due reviews remain available across categories while chapter weak/new cards are added.

title: Audit-driven student flow improvements
description: Parent epic for the Playwright flow audit findings from output/playwright/audit.md. Goal: make the student entry into vocabulary practice simpler, separate review/new-card intent cleanly, improve accessibility of action cards, and polish game setup/play states.
acceptance_criteria: All child issues from the Playwright audit are either implemented, closed as superseded with rationale, or explicitly deferred.
close_reason: Accepted audit findings implemented and verified across vocabulary, verbs, grammar, and games.

title: Redesign vocabulary launcher around three session intents
description: Replace the dense default vocabulary setup with a simple student-first launcher. The first choice should be: Repetere ord, Repetere ord og lære nye ord, or Lære nye ord. Move statistics, import/export, add glossary, and advanced category management behind secondary actions.
acceptance_criteria: After login, the primary vocabulary screen presents the three session choices clearly in the first viewport. The student can start a reasonable default session with minimal decisions. Existing export/import and add-glossary flows remain available but secondary.
close_reason: Implemented three-intent vocabulary launcher after dependency flow was closed. Verified with focused and browser Playwright checks.

title: Decouple review cards from new-card category selection
description: Change vocabulary session selection so repeat modes include all due cards regardless of selected new-card category. New-card modes should let students choose category and number of new cards. Mixed mode should include all due cards plus chosen new cards.
acceptance_criteria: Review-only sessions include all due cards and allow a max-card or max-time limit. Mixed sessions include all due cards plus selected new cards from one or more chosen categories. New-only sessions draw only from chosen categories. The old export/import progress format still works.
close_reason: Implemented audit-driven vocabulary launcher, review/new-card flow, semantic controls, game prompt positioning, recommended Verbo defaults, and visual tone improvements. Verified with focused and browser Playwright checks.

title: Replace clickable cards with semantic buttons and focus states
description: Several action cards are rendered as divs with onclick handlers, including vocabulary categories, grammar topics, and game cards. Replace these with semantic button elements or equivalent accessible controls, with keyboard support and visible focus states.
acceptance_criteria: Vocabulary category chips, grammar topic cards, and game cards can be reached and activated by keyboard. Focus is visible. Pointer behavior remains unchanged. Playwright/a11y selectors can target roles rather than div click handlers.
close_reason: Implemented audit-driven vocabulary launcher, review/new-card flow, semantic controls, game prompt positioning, recommended Verbo defaults, and visual tone improvements. Verified with focused and browser Playwright checks.

title: Make game prompt visible before answers are actionable
description: In Verbo Invaders and Prepo Invaders, the running state initially shows HUD and answer cards while the prompt starts above the viewport. Students can see possible answers before the question is visible.
acceptance_criteria: When either game starts, the student sees the question/prompt before or at the same time as answers become actionable. A countdown or fixed prompt preview is acceptable. Existing keyboard controls still work.
close_reason: Implemented audit-driven vocabulary launcher, review/new-card flow, semantic controls, game prompt positioning, recommended Verbo defaults, and visual tone improvements. Verified with focused and browser Playwright checks.

title: Improve Verbo Invaders default verb selection

acceptance_criteria: A new game starts with a pedagogically reasonable default set instead of all verbs, or asks the student to choose a focus. Students can still select all verbs manually. The setup makes it clear what will be practiced.
close_reason: Implemented audit-driven vocabulary launcher, review/new-card flow, semantic controls, game prompt positioning, recommended Verbo defaults, and visual tone improvements. Verified with focused and browser Playwright checks.
